Exercise 6. a) Issa. / lissa ma-kaltiš. · b) aywa, lissa wāṣil. · c) laʾ, ʿumri ma-ruḥt Aswān. · d) aywa, ḫalāṣ ḫallaṣtu. · e) lissa ma-šuftūš. · f) aywa, ikibt ṭayyāra marrāt kitīr. Exercise 7. Yāsmīn: she woke up early, went to college, finished her classes at two o'clock, was in a coffee with her friends · she did not study at all (she was tired). Mīna: he worked until seven o'clock, played soccer with the team, returned home at ten o'clock and went straight to sleep · did not have dinner. ʿAmm Fatḥi: new merchandise has arrived from Egypt (fūl, dates, bread), opened early, settled everything · did not sit a minute. Exercise 8. a) At Lake Como, with friends, Saturday. In the car; They left at 7:00. They walked on the lake, ate fish in a small restaurant and took a boat ride, from which they saw the villas. Šarīf He didn't leave the house. He studied for the math exam. It went well: he solved everything except one question that he did not understand at all. b) Because he called him last night and didn't answer. Pasta, and the mother protests: again pasta! He still doesn't know the test results. What? Šarīf She hasn't called her in a week. To come and eat from them when he is in Egypt. What happened yesterday? · 18. I've never eaten. ṭaʿmiyya First. · 19. We left early and returned at night. · 20. I didn't get it at all. For parts A and B vocals, the tutor accepts natural variants (gā for gih, itnēn kīlu for kilutēn) and removes the point if missing -š or if the form is of fuṣḥā.
